rationale: Task T13 requires a CFO brief synthesizing findings from the portfolio deep-dive (T11) and high-cost model (T12). The plan collects metrics from both sources, composes an executive brief with the four required sections (key findings, model performance, limitations, next steps), uses causal language appropriate for executive communication, and includes artifact citations for traceability. The supporting report documents synthetic data and model limitations as caveats, with citations but no denominators for clean CFO presentation.
